grades.lower_bound_mechanism: transversal-hypergraph compactness via killing property (K) — incomplete
grades.upper_bound_mechanism: L = lcm of minimal elements; T = count per window of length L
grades.notes: Step 1 proves (C) rigorously. Step 2 proves (P) fully and globally: L = lcm of minimal elements (product of primes), T = count in [a_1, a_1+L), giving a_{n+T}=a_n+L for all n. Step 3 is rigorous. Finiteness (F) is NOT proved: peeling is complete, killing property (K) and (C1) derived, but the compactness crux is an acknowledged open gap with repair only in progress.
